definitions.explanation: The main structural body of a vehicle, including cars, trains, and buses. Refers to the outer shell and frame, as distinct from the engine or interior.

examples.japanese: {車体|しゃたい}の{色|いろ}は{赤|あか}だ。
{車体|しゃたい}に{傷|きず}が{付|つ}いてしまった。
この{電車|でんしゃ}はアルミニウム{製|せい}の{軽|かる}い{車体|しゃたい}を{採用|さいよう}している。
examples.english: This train uses a lightweight aluminum body.

notes:
{車体|しゃたい} refers to the outer body and frame of a vehicle, as distinct from the engine, wheels, or interior. It applies to any vehicle — cars, trains, buses, and trucks.

WORD FORMATION:
{車|しゃ} (vehicle) + {体|たい} (body/structure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車体|しゃたい}の{色|いろ}: body color
- {車体|しゃたい}に{傷|きず}が{付|つ}く: to get a scratch on the body
- {車体|しゃたい}{番号|ばんごう}: chassis number, vehicle identification number
- {車体|しゃたい}を{磨|みが}く: to polish the car body
- {車体|しゃたい}カバー: car cover

CONTRAST:
{車体|しゃたい} is the physical body/frame. {車種|しゃしゅ} refers to the model or type of vehicle. {車両|しゃりょう} means a vehicle as a whole unit, especially for trains.
